title: Aefinn's craftable light blocks
description: Recipe for light blocks that are normally creative mode only
body:
Light blocks are fantastic for adding discreet lighting for builds but unfortunately they are behind commands/creative menu. This datapack adds a custom recipe for them. This also gives an alternative use for glow squid ink. Thanks to LocutusofNord for the original recipe idea.
